## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-06-21 — do not edit manually*

### Environment
*~4,000 tokens/session saved*
- `gh` CLI and `timeout` are NOT installed on this macOS box. Use `curl`/`git ls-remote` instead of `gh`, and drop `timeout` (or use a background job) — both fail with command_not_found.
- python3 has NO `yaml` module. Validate OpenAPI/YAML with `node -e "require('js-yaml')..."` or a JSON-only check; `python3 -c "import yaml"` fails (module_not_found).
- WebFetch on github.com is blocked (domain-verify/connection error). Use `git clone --depth 1`, `curl`, or `raw.githubusercontent.com` to inspect repos.

### File Paths
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- Active design docs: `dashboard-docs/system/adapter-recorder-system/` (00–11 modules + adr/ + schemas/ with `adapter-recorder.bundle.json`), baseline spec `dashboard-docs/TDD.md`. Three-layer doc root `dashboard-docs/{system,ui,api}`; `architecture-relationship.md` is the living three-layer doc.
- `src/cli.ts` is large — grep for the command/case before reading; read only the matched offset range.

### Project Facts (bycli rebrand)
*~2,500 tokens/session saved*
- Project was rebranded opencli → bycli: npm package `@sovovs/bycli`, bin `bycli`, repo `github.com/sovovs/byCLI`, daemon custom header `X-byCLI`, `DEFAULT_DAEMON_PORT=19825` (src/constants.ts).
- User data/adapters live in `~/.bycli/` (was `~/.opencli/`); repo adapters in `clis/<site>/`.

### Commands
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
- Build: `npm run build`; rebuild adapter index: `npm run build-manifest`; tests: `npx vitest run <file>` (add `--project e2e` for e2e tests), typecheck `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- Global link for local testing: `npm link` exposes the `bycli` bin; if browser cmds fail with BROWSER_CONNECT, kill the stale daemon and rerun.
